|--------|---------------------|--------------------|-----------------|
| 2022‑2023 | Kai Parris (6 ft 7 in) and Alhaji Fofana (6 ft 5 in) | 6 ft 7 in + 6 ft 5 in | **13 ft 2 in** |

- 2022‑23 roster: Kai Parris – 6'7" (https://lehmanathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/2022-23), Alhaji Fofana – 6'5" (same page).

**Answer:** Neither combined height is greater; they are equal at 13 ft 2 in.
